meta.title: Autostatistika — Estonian vehicle statistics
meta.description: Open data from the Estonian Transport Administration on vehicle registrations, the vehicle fleet and technical inspections. Independent and interactive.

hero.headline: See what moves in Estonia.
hero.lede: Open data from the Estonian Transport Administration on registrations, the vehicle fleet and technical inspections. Verified figures in one place, with nothing made up.

heroRace.title: Brands in first registrations
heroRace.subtitle: Monthly first registrations by brand, new and used combined. As ranked by the source.
heroRace.rowLabel: Rank {rank}: {brand}, {value} vehicles, {share} of the month's first registrations. Open in comparison.
heroRace.readout: – {share} of the month's first registrations, rank {rank}, {period}.
heroRace.hint: Pick a brand to compare it. The source lists {count} brands.
heroRace.gapTitle: {distance} until the next imported month, months in between are not imported
heroRace.gapNote: Hatched stretches have no imported data. The months are not consecutive.
heroRace.gapNoteDense: {count} months. Hatched stretches have no brand ranking for this type. Drag or use the arrow keys.

tabHints.registreerimised: Flow: vehicles registered in Estonia for the first time during a month.
tabHints.soidukipark: Stock: vehicles in the register on a given date.
tabHints.ulevaatused: Events: technical inspections at stations and their outcomes.

explorer.title: Statistics
explorer.lede: Three datasets, one workspace. Every selection goes into the address bar, so any view can be shared as it is.
explorer.loadError: The data for this selection did not load. The previous view is still shown.

filters.noBrand: No such brand in this vehicle type's rankings.
filters.maxCompare: You can compare up to {max} brands. Remove one to add another.
filters.unavailable: This dataset has no {dims}. Filters that could not change the data are not shown.

source.label: Data provenance
source.limitation: Missing is not zero. A stock is not a flow. A repeat inspection is not a brand-quality score.

reg.firstInfo: Vehicles entered in the Estonian register for the first time during the month. Includes new vehicles and used vehicles brought in from abroad.
reg.newInfo: New vehicles among first registrations (the Infoleht row “sh uued”).
reg.usedInfo: First registrations minus new. A used vehicle's first entry in Estonia, not a change of owner.
reg.privateInfo: New vehicles registered to a private owner (the row “neist uued omanik era”).
reg.mixHint: Pick a row to view that type.
reg.historyTitle: {count, plural, one {# imported month} other {# imported months}}, {from}–{to}
reg.historyDescription: First registrations in each imported month, type: {category}. Pick a month to change the whole view.
reg.historyInfo: Columns are imported months only. Hatched gaps show how much time lies between them. Months in between are never estimated or drawn.
reg.gapTitle: {distance} apart, months in between not imported
reg.seasonNote: The months come from different times of year (January, November, September), so they are not seasonally comparable.
reg.brandsDescription: First registrations by brand, {period}. New and used combined.
reg.brandsInfo: Brands from the source TOP sheet. A brand's total is the sum of the sheet's first-registration-year columns. A brand missing from the ranking is not zero.
reg.brandsHint: Click a brand to add it to the comparison (up to {max}).
reg.brandsUnavailableBody: Infoleht brand rankings are imported for passenger cars and trucks. Brand splits for other types are not estimated.
reg.noBrandMonth: No brand ranking imported for this month
reg.tipFoot: Share = brand first registrations / type first registrations in the same month.
reg.fuelInfo: Infoleht sheet “Kütus esm (sh uued)”. Used = first registrations minus new for the same fuel. Shares are of the sum of listed fuels.
reg.fuelLead: The largest group is {fuel}: {share} of listed fuels.
reg.fuelUnavailableBody: The fuel sheet exists in recent Infoleht files. Pick a month where it was imported:
reg.fuelNone: No fuel split is imported for this vehicle type.
reg.yoy: Same month a year earlier ({period}): {value}. Change {change}.
reg.yoyMissing: No data for the same month a year earlier.

compare.title: Compare brands
compare.description: Pick up to four brands and see how their first registrations changed across the imported months. Type: {category}.
compare.info: Count is the month's first registrations. Share is the brand's first registrations divided by the type's first registrations in the same month. If a brand is missing from a month's ranking, its point stays empty.
compare.emptyBody: Add brands above or click a brand in the ranking. The selection is saved in the link, so you can share the comparison.
compare.axisNote: Lines join neighbouring imported months. The “+” on the axis shows the time gap.
compare.missingNote: Empty point: the brand was not in that month's ranking.
compare.sourceNote: Brands come from each month's TOP sheet. Brands outside the ranking are not counted as zero.
compare.axisNoteDense: One point per month. A break in a line means the brand was not in that month's ranking.

models.title: New passenger cars by model
models.description: First registrations of new passenger cars by model, {period}.
models.info: Infoleht sheet “Sõidu-uus”: new passenger cars only. Share of brand = model / sum of the brand's listed models in the same month. History columns show the same model in other imported months.
models.emptyPeriod: No model data imported for this month
models.emptyPeriodBody: The model sheet is imported for these months:

fleet.stockInfo: Vehicles in the register on a given date. This is a stock, not a flow: counts from different dates are never added. From 12/2014 the source notes that the count includes suspended registrations; earlier leaflets do not say, but the series continues without a break. For 31.12.2014 the source also gives the registered-only count.
fleet.statusNote: The source also includes suspended records. The headline figure is therefore the sum of all statuses and is labelled as such.
fleet.historyNote: Each row is a separate snapshot. They are compared side by side, never added.
fleet.historySingle: Only one snapshot is imported for this type.
fleet.compositionNote: Pick a type to see its counties, age and brands.
fleet.countyDescription: {category} in the register by county, as of {date}.
fleet.countyInfo: Tile map: each tile is one county, placed roughly by geography. Colour uses a log scale because Harju is several times larger than the rest. Share = county / sum of county rows.
fleet.countyNote: County rows sum to {total}. This can differ slightly from the register total when some records have no county.
fleet.countyUnavailable: No county split for this snapshot
fleet.countyUnavailableBody: Counties are imported for these snapshots:
fleet.countyNone: No county split is imported for this type.
fleet.ageDescription: {category} by age band, each snapshot separately.
fleet.ageInfo: Age bands come from the Infoleht age sheet. Bars show the share of the same snapshot's total.
fleet.ageNote: Pick a row to switch snapshot.
fleet.ageUnavailableBody: The age sheet is imported for passenger cars, trucks, trailers and motorcycles.
fleet.brandDescription: {category} in the register by brand, as of {date}.
fleet.brandInfo: Two kinds of source: bus register files give a complete brand split (shown when it matches the stock to within 90%); the Infoleht “most registered” table lists only the largest brands. List share = brand / whole fleet on the same date.
fleet.brandNotReconciled: Brand rows don't match the snapshot
fleet.brandNotReconciledBody: Brand rows for this snapshot add up to {sum}, but the register holds {stock} vehicles. They come from a different grain, so they are not shown as the fleet's brand split.
fleet.brandUnavailable: No brand split for this snapshot
fleet.brandUnavailableBody: Brands are imported for the bus register snapshots.
fleet.brandTopDescription: The source's {count} brands with the most vehicles, type: {category}, as of {date}.
fleet.brandTopNote: These {count} brands hold {share} of the fleet. The other {rest} vehicles belong to brands the source list does not name.

insp.totalInfo: Technical inspection events at stations during the month. One vehicle can be inspected more than once.
insp.passInfo: Passed inspections / all inspections in the same group and month.
insp.repeatInfo: Directed to repeat inspection / all inspections. This is an inspection outcome, not a count of unique vehicles.
insp.outcomeDescription: Each row is one imported month and group. Pick a row to change the whole view.
insp.outcomeInfo: Passed and repeat are source columns. “Other outcome” is inspections minus passed minus repeat.
insp.restNote: Other outcome = inspections − passed − repeat. The source does not name these outcomes separately.
insp.caution: A repeat inspection is not a brand-reliability score. The monthly reports have no brand or model, so no brand conclusions are drawn.
insp.stationsInfo: Station repeat share = station repeats / station inspections.
insp.stationsPartial: This import has {count} station rows with {sum} inspections. The national total is {total}, so the list covers {share}. The station comparison is not the full national picture.
insp.stationsNone: No station rows imported for this month
insp.trendDescription: Top: number of inspections. Bottom: share sent to repeat inspection. Pick a month to change the whole view.
insp.trendInfo: Two panels on one time axis, so the count and the share never distort each other's scale. Months without a report stay empty.

insights.title: Notes from the numbers
insights.lede: Calculated from the published data. Each note shows its evidence and opens the exact slice of the data it describes.
insights.evidence: {count, plural, one {# piece of evidence} other {# pieces of evidence}}
insights.deterministic: Rule-based sentence, not rephrased by a language model.
insights.modelPhrased: Phrased by a language model, figures checked against evidence.

method.title: Where the data comes from
method.lede: Autostatistika republishes Transport Administration statistics. It does not estimate missing months and does not reconstruct history from today's register.
method.coverageHint: Solid bars are consecutive imported months, diamonds single snapshots.
method.principlesTitle: Rules that keep the numbers honest

flows.title: Flows and stocks are different things
flows.body: Registrations are flows: a September 2026 first registration is a vehicle entered in the register during that month. The fleet is a stock: the register on a given date. Stocks are never added across dates.

newUsed.title: A first registration is not necessarily a new vehicle
newUsed.body: The Infoleht row “Kokku” is all first registrations; “sh uued” is new vehicles. Used = total minus new: a vehicle's first entry in Estonia after coming from abroad, not a change of owner. Aftermarket transactions are never added to first registrations.

yearColumns.title: Year columns on TOP sheets are vehicle age
yearColumns.body: The columns “2026”, “2025” and so on are the vehicle's own first-registration year, not a monthly series. A brand's monthly total is the sum of those columns.

repeat.title: A repeat inspection is not a quality score
repeat.body: A repeat is the outcome of an inspection event, not a unique faulty vehicle. The monthly reports have no brand or model, so no claims about brand reliability are made.

missing.title: Missing is not zero
missing.body: Empty cells stay empty. When a brand is missing from a month's ranking, it reads “not ranked”, never zero. Months that were not imported are hatched.

shares.title: Every share names its denominator
shares.body: New-vehicle share = new / first registrations. Brand share = brand first registrations / type first registrations in the same month. Repeat share = repeats / all inspections in the same group and month.

method.licence: Public-sector open data. When reusing, credit the source: Transpordiamet.

footer.note: Figures come from files published by the Transport Administration. Autostatistika never presents statistics as more recent, precise or complete than the source allows.
